longTitle.officialTitle: To remove the 4-year sunset from the Pro bono Work to Empower and Represent Act of 2018.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Pro bono Work to Empower and Represent Act of 2021” or the “POWER 2.0 Act”.

section.heading: REMOVAL OF SUNSET.
section.content: Section 3(a) of the Pro bono Work to Empower and Represent Act of 2018 (Public Law 115-237; 132 Stat. 2448) is amended by striking “for a period of 4 years”.
